name: North Dakota Governor's School
org: NDSU Office of Teaching and Learning and University of North Dakota
city: Fargo or Grand Forks, ND (host switches between NDSU and UND)
what_you_do: A four week summer program. You live and study on the NDSU campus. Students rank their top two pathways from Engineering, Information Technology, Laboratory Science or Mathematics. The NDSU page lists dates of June 8 to July 2, 2026 for NDGS 2026.
who_can_apply: Current 10th or 11th graders who live in North Dakota. You can attend a public or non-public school. You need a cumulative GPA of 3.25 or higher. Selection uses a personal essay of 250 words or less. It also uses two recommendations (one teacher, one counselor or administrator) and a transcript.
pay_detail: The NDSU pages do not list a cost. A UND article says a North Dakota Department of Public Instruction grant covered tuition and on-campus housing for the 2025 session. Check that this still holds.
duration: Four weeks. 2026 dates were June 8 to July 2.
deadline_text: The NDSU page shows the NDGS 2026 timeline with no year on the later dates: portal opened October 13, 2025 and closed February 15, 2026; acceptance emails March 12 (year not shown); accept by April 10 (year not shown). The 2026 program ran June 8 to July 2. The next session's dates are not posted on the program pages.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the NDSU Governor's School site (2026 cycle). You need a personal essay of 250 words or less. You also need one teacher recommendation. You need one counselor or administrator recommendation too. Questions? Email ndsu.otl@ndsu.edu.
notes: The NDSU page says the program runs every other summer. The next session's host, dates and portal are not posted on the program pages. Ask NDSU at ndsu.otl@ndsu.edu.
